FAQ'S
1. What is Siya Tattva, and how will it benefit me?

Siya Tattva is a unique spiritual sadhana designed to invoke the divine energy of Mata Sita within aspirants. This energy acts as a catalyst to amplify your mantra shakti, enhance your ojas (spiritual glow), and strengthen your relationships. It helps you overcome obstacles in your sadhana and attracts harmony in your personal and spiritual life.
2. Who can enroll in the Siya Tattva Sadhana?

The Sadhana is open to all spiritual members of Ashaeiynn family who wish to enhance their sadhana results, improve their relationships, or overcome blockages in their spiritual growth. Whether you’re a beginner or an experienced sadhak, Siya Tattva is designed to benefit all levels.
3. What will I receive during the Siya Tattva Sadhana?
During the Sadhana, you will:
Receive Mata Sita’s divine tattva, which acts as a catalyst for your spiritual journey.
Experience a significant increase in your ojas (spiritual glow) and energy.
Strengthen your relationships with your partner, friends, and family.
Overcome obstacles like dosh or other issues preventing marriage or life harmony.
4. How long does the Siya Tattva sadhana last?
The sadhana includes 11 days of intensive sadhana every month, during which you will receive personalized guidance and blessings. You can continue participating monthly for deeper spiritual benefits.
5. Who will guide us during the Siya Tattva sadhana?

The sadhana will be led by Dr. Parikshit Ghotia, the founder of Ashaeiynn. He will personally perform sadhana alongside participants and provide guidance, invoking blessings from Gurudev Hanuman Ji Maharaj.
6. Is this sadhana conducted online or in person?
Siya Tattva is conducted remotely, allowing aspirants to participate from anywhere in the world. Personalized guidance and instructions are provided to ensure a transformative experience.
7. Will Siya Tattva help me if I have difficulty generating mantra shakti?

Yes! Siya Tattva is specifically designed for aspirants who struggle to generate energy or shakti from their mantra sadhana. Mata Sita’s divine tattva acts as a catalyst to empower your mantra shakti and help you achieve the desired results.
8. Is there any support available during the sadhana?
Yes, you will receive ongoing support and guidance from the Ashaeiynn team and Dr. Parikshit Ghotia during the course to address any questions or challenges you may face.
9. Can this sadhana help improve my relationships?
Absolutely! Siya Tattva enhances your inner energy and ojas, which positively impacts your ability to attract and build strong, harmonious relationships with your partner, family, and friends.
10. I’m facing obstacles in getting married. Will Siya Tattva help?

Yes, Siya Tattva can help aspirants who face challenges in marriage due to dosh or other spiritual blockages. The energy of Mata Sita and the special sadhana conducted during the course can remove these obstacles and create a harmonious path forward.
11. Do I need prior experience in sadhana to join this sadhana?
No prior experience is required. Siya Tattva is designed to benefit aspirants of all levels, whether you are just starting your spiritual journey or have years of experience in sadhana.
12. What practices are included in the Siya Tattva sadhana?

The sadhana includes a combination of japa (chanting), dhyana (meditation), tapa (spiritual discipline), and a special hawan (fire ritual) performed for all participants. These practices are guided by Dr. Parikshit Ghotia to ensure maximum spiritual benefits.
13. How can I enroll in the Siya Tattva sadhana?
You can enroll by visiting our website, and after that filling out the registration form available on the Ashaeiynn App.
14. How soon can I see results from the Siya Tattva sadhana?
Results vary depending on individual effort and dedication. Many aspirants experience immediate shifts in their energy, relationships, and spiritual journey after completing the 11-day sadhana.
